title: KSTAR 韓國超導托卡馬克
summary: KSTAR 位於韓國大田，2008 年產生第一個電漿，環向場線圈採用與 ITER 相同的鈮三錫超導體；2024 年公布把一億度的離子溫度維持了 48 秒、高約束模維持了 102 秒。課程定量分析溫度的單位換算、線圈上的峰值磁場、低溫系統，以及 2023 年換裝的鎢偏濾器的導熱溫差。
summaryEn: KSTAR in Daejeon, Korea, made its first plasma in 2008 with toroidal field coils of the same niobium-tin superconductor as ITER; in 2024 it reported holding an ion temperature of a hundred million degrees for 48 seconds and high-confinement mode for 102 seconds. The course quantifies the unit conversion for temperature, peak field on the coil, the cryogenic system, and conduction temperature difference in the tungsten divertor fitted in 2023.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與標準架構編寫的原創教學。步驟是可驗證的分析、估算與檢核任務，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、運轉程序或作業許可。核能內容僅限公開的熱循環、功能架構、土木與安全理念，不包含燃料製備、濃縮、再處理、武器、反應度整定、反應爐操作或保安細節。數值為公開標稱值或教學假設，實際工程須由合格專業人員依規範與實測資料重新計算並負責。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and standards frameworks. Steps are verifiable analysis, estimation and checking tasks, not drawings, method statements, operating procedures or permits. Nuclear content is limited to public thermal cycles, functional architecture, civil works and safety concepts and excludes fuel production, enrichment, reprocessing, weapons, reactivity settings, reactor operation and security details. Numbers are public nominal values or teaching assumptions; real work must be recalculated by qualified professionals using codes and measured data.
v30Focus: 全鈮三錫超導托卡馬克：一億度的意義、線圈峰值磁場與鎢偏濾器的溫差
v30FocusEn: A tokamak with niobium-tin magnets: what a hundred million degrees means, peak field on the coil and temperature difference across a tungsten divertor

stages.title: 資源、需求與系統架構：KSTAR 韓國超導托卡馬克
stages.titleEn: Resource, demand and system architecture: KSTAR Korea Superconducting Tokamak
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「裝置尺寸與電漿體積」與「一億度的意義」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Device size and plasma volume" and "What a hundred million degrees means": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

quiz.question: 關於「裝置尺寸與電漿體積」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Device size and plasma volume" is correct?
options: 托卡馬克的電漿是一個甜甜圈形的環：大半徑 R 是環中心到電漿中心的距離，小半徑 a 是電漿截面的半寬，兩者之比稱為長寬比。
融合裝置做得大只是因為技術還不成熟，將來一定可以縮小到桌面大小。
一億度的電漿會把任何容器都燒穿。
optionsEn: A tokamak plasma is a doughnut-shaped ring: major radius R runs from the centre of the torus to the plasma centre, minor radius a is the half-width of the cross-section, and their ratio is the aspect ratio.
Fusion devices are large only because the technology is immature and will certainly shrink to tabletop size.
Plasma at a hundred million degrees would burn through any container.
quiz.explanation: 托卡馬克的電漿是一個甜甜圈形的環：大半徑 R 是環中心到電漿中心的距離，小半徑 a 是電漿截面的半寬，兩者之比稱為長寬比。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A tokamak plasma is a doughnut-shaped ring: major radius R runs from the centre of the torus to the plasma centre, minor radius a is the half-width of the cross-section, and their ratio is the aspect ratio. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 裝置尺寸與電漿體積：機制與能量路徑
steps.titleEn: Device size and plasma volume: mechanism and energy path
steps.objective: 說明「裝置尺寸與電漿體積」如何決定「KSTAR 韓國超導托卡馬克」的能量轉換、輸送、儲存或安全功能，並畫出輸入、轉換、損失與系統邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Device size and plasma volume” governs energy conversion, transfer, storage or safety functions in “KSTAR Korea Superconducting Tokamak”, and map inputs, conversions, losses and the system boundary.
steps.instruction: 托卡馬克的電漿是一個甜甜圈形的環：大半徑 R 是環中心到電漿中心的距離，小半徑 a 是電漿截面的半寬，兩者之比稱為長寬比。電漿體積大致與 R·a² 成正比，並因截面拉長而增大。體積越大，表面積對體積的比越小，能量越不容易流失，這是融合裝置必須做得很大的根本原因；球形托卡馬克則以很小的長寬比換取較高的比壓。 師傅任務：畫出這個單元的能量與物質流圖（輸入、轉換、損失、輸出、邊界），標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由資源、環境或運轉決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A tokamak plasma is a doughnut-shaped ring: major radius R runs from the centre of the torus to the plasma centre, minor radius a is the half-width of the cross-section, and their ratio is the aspect ratio. Plasma volume scales roughly with R·a² and grows with elongation. A larger volume has a smaller surface-to-volume ratio and loses energy less easily, the basic reason fusion devices must be big; spherical tokamaks trade a very low aspect ratio for higher beta. Mentor task: draw the energy and material flow of this unit (inputs, conversions, losses, outputs, boundary), mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by resource, environment or operation, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 工程檔案：大半徑 1.8 m、小半徑 0.5 m，中心磁場 3.5 T
steps.observationEn: Project file: Major radius is 1.8 m and minor radius 0.5 m with an on-axis field of 3.5 T
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「融合裝置做得大只是因為技術還不成熟，將來一定可以縮小到桌面大小。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在流程圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Fusion devices are large only because the technology is immature and will certainly shrink to tabletop size." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your flow diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 流程圖標明「裝置尺寸與電漿體積」的輸入、轉換、損失與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The flow diagram shows inputs, conversions, losses and boundary for “Device size and plasma volume”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: A tokamak plasma is a doughnut-shaped ring: major radius R runs from the centre of the torus to the plasma centre, minor radius a is the half-width of the cross-section, and their ratio is the aspect ratio. Plasma volume scales roughly with R·a² and grows with elongation. A larger volume has a smaller surface-to-volume ratio and loses energy less easily, the basic reason fusion devices must be big; spherical tokamaks trade a very low aspect ratio for higher beta.

knowledge.text: 誤解：融合裝置做得大只是因為技術還不成熟，將來一定可以縮小到桌面大小。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。

knowledge.title: 工程檔案

quiz.question: 依「裝置尺寸與電漿體積」的模型 V ≈ 2·π²·R·a²·κ，以橢圓截面近似的電漿體積最接近下列何者？
quiz.questionEn: Using the model V ≈ 2·π²·R·a²·κ for "Device size and plasma volume", which value is closest to the plasma volume approximated with an elliptical cross-section?
options: 18 m³
178 m³
optionsEn: 18 m³
178 m³
quiz.explanation: V ≈ 2·π²·R·a²·κ；代入 R = 1.8 m、a = 0.5 m、κ = 2.0，得 18 m³（以橢圓截面近似的電漿體積）。 其餘選項是倍數或數量級錯誤。
quiz.explanationEn: V ≈ 2·π²·R·a²·κ; with R = 1.8 m, a = 0.5 m, κ = 2.0 the result is 18 m³ (plasma volume approximated with an elliptical cross-section). The other options are factor or order-of-magnitude errors.

steps.title: 裝置尺寸與電漿體積：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Device size and plasma volume: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「裝置尺寸與電漿體積」的關鍵量，並判斷輸入改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantity of “Device size and plasma volume” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when an input moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：V ≈ 2·π²·R·a²·κ；代入 R = 1.8 m、a = 0.5 m、κ = 2.0，得 18 m³（以橢圓截面近似的電漿體積）。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次；再把 a 增加 10%，先預測再計算輸出，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出設計或規範通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: V ≈ 2·π²·R·a²·κ; with R = 1.8 m, a = 0.5 m, κ = 2.0 the result is 18 m³ (plasma volume approximated with an elliptical cross-section). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units; then raise a by 10%, predict before computing the output, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how designers or codes usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 敏感度核對：a 增加 10% 時，結果變為 21 m³（+21.0%）。
steps.observationEn: Sensitivity check: Raising a by 10% changes the result to 21 m³ (+21.0%).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成實機設計值、混淆額定值與實際運轉值，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as plant design values, mixing rated and actual operating values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later decisions.
steps.check: 重現 18 m³（取整誤差 ±2% 內），並提交 a 改變 10% 的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce 18 m³ (within ±2% rounding) and submit the sensitivity calculation for a 10% change in a with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: V ≈ 2·π²·R·a²·κ；代入 R = 1.8 m、a = 0.5 m、κ = 2.0，得 18 m³（以橢圓截面近似的電漿體積）。
knowledge.textEn: V ≈ 2·π²·R·a²·κ; with R = 1.8 m, a = 0.5 m, κ = 2.0 the result is 18 m³ (plasma volume approximated with an elliptical cross-section).

knowledge.title: 敏感度
knowledge.text: a 增加 10% 時，結果變為 21 m³（+21.0%）。 先預測方向與次方，再用計算確認。
knowledge.textEn: Raising a by 10% changes the result to 21 m³ (+21.0%). Predict direction and exponent first, then confirm by calculation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為公開標稱值或教學假設的簡化；套用到實際設備前，必須依規範、製造商資料與現場量測重新計算。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are public nominal values or simplified teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, recalculate with codes, manufacturer data and site measurements.

quiz.question: 要驗證「裝置尺寸與電漿體積」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Device size and plasma volume"?
options: 量測時不必記錄環境溫度、負載與運轉模式，因為它們不影響結果。
超導線圈失超時只是暫時不能用，等一下自己就會恢復。
由磁診斷重建的平衡（如 EFIT）取得每次放電的實際 R、a、拉長比與體積，並與設計值及真空室限制器位置比對。
optionsEn: Ambient temperature, load and operating mode need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A quenched superconducting coil is only briefly unavailable and recovers by itself.

Take actual R, a, elongation and volume of each discharge from equilibrium reconstruction such as EFIT based on magnetic diagnostics, and compare with design values and limiter positions in the vessel.
quiz.explanation: 由磁診斷重建的平衡（如 EFIT）取得每次放電的實際 R、a、拉長比與體積，並與設計值及真空室限制器位置比對。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Take actual R, a, elongation and volume of each discharge from equilibrium reconstruction such as EFIT based on magnetic diagnostics, and compare with design values and limiter positions in the vessel. Verification needs a baseline, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 裝置尺寸與電漿體積：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Device size and plasma volume: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「裝置尺寸與電漿體積」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停留點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Device size and plasma volume” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 由磁診斷重建的平衡（如 EFIT）取得每次放電的實際 R、a、拉長比與體積，並與設計值及真空室限制器位置比對。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器、基準或校正、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停留點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Take actual R, a, elongation and volume of each discharge from equilibrium reconstruction such as EFIT based on magnetic diagnostics, and compare with design values and limiter positions in the vessel. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments, baseline or calibration, procedure, comparison, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：每次放電的平衡重建結果要與控制系統的即時估算比對並存檔，作為判斷診斷漂移與控制裕度的依據。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Equilibrium reconstructions of each discharge should be compared with real-time control estimates and archived as the basis for judging diagnostic drift and control margin.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：電漿截面拉長可以提高性能，但也使垂直位置不穩定；控制系統反應不及時，電漿會在毫秒內撞向上方或下方的壁面，造成垂直位移事件。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境與運轉條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Elongating the cross-section improves performance but makes vertical position unstable; if the control system is too slow the plasma hits the upper or lower wall within milliseconds in a vertical displacement event. A single reading, no traceable baseline, or unrecorded ambient and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停留點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, baseline, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 由磁診斷重建的平衡（如 EFIT）取得每次放電的實際 R、a、拉長比與體積，並與設計值及真空室限制器位置比對。
knowledge.textEn: Take actual R, a, elongation and volume of each discharge from equilibrium reconstruction such as EFIT based on magnetic diagnostics, and compare with design values and limiter positions in the vessel.

knowledge.textEn: Equilibrium reconstructions of each discharge should be compared with real-time control estimates and archived as the basis for judging diagnostic drift and control margin.

knowledge.textEn: A public code or guide to compare against: ITER Research Plan and technical baseline documents (public versions). Confirm edition and applicability before citing it.

quiz.question: 在「裝置尺寸與電漿體積」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Device size and plasma volume" shows an anomaly, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 電漿截面拉長可以提高性能，但也使垂直位置不穩定；控制系統反應不及時，電漿會在毫秒內撞向上方或下方的壁面，造成垂直位移事件。
所有異常都是操作人員失誤，設計、製造與維護不需要檢討。
一億度的電漿會把任何容器都燒穿。
optionsEn: Elongating the cross-section improves performance but makes vertical position unstable.
Every anomaly is operator error, so design, manufacturing and maintenance never need review.
Plasma at a hundred million degrees would burn through any container.
quiz.explanation: 電漿截面拉長可以提高性能，但也使垂直位置不穩定；控制系統反應不及時，電漿會在毫秒內撞向上方或下方的壁面，造成垂直位移事件。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Elongating the cross-section improves performance but makes vertical position unstable; if the control system is too slow the plasma hits the upper or lower wall within milliseconds in a vertical displacement event. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 裝置尺寸與電漿體積：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Device size and plasma volume: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「裝置尺寸與電漿體積」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or degradation causes of “Device size and plasma volume” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 電漿截面拉長可以提高性能，但也使垂直位置不穩定；控制系統反應不及時，電漿會在毫秒內撞向上方或下方的壁面，造成垂直位移事件。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢查，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響「KSTAR 韓國超導托卡馬克」的安全、出力、壽命或併網。
steps.instructionEn: Elongating the cross-section improves performance but makes vertical position unstable; if the control system is too slow the plasma hits the upper or lower wall within milliseconds in a vertical displacement event. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects safety, output, life or grid connection of “KSTAR Korea Superconducting Tokamak”.
steps.observation: 連結機制：體積越大，表面積對體積的比越小，能量越不容易流失，這是融合裝置必須做得很大的根本原因；球形托卡馬克則以很小的長寬比換取較高的比壓。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A larger volume has a smaller surface-to-volume ratio and loses energy less easily, the basic reason fusion devices must be big; spherical tokamaks trade a very low aspect ratio for higher beta.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「融合裝置做得大只是因為技術還不成熟，將來一定可以縮小到桌面大小。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Fusion devices are large only because the technology is immature and will certainly shrink to tabletop size." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢查能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 電漿截面拉長可以提高性能，但也使垂直位置不穩定；控制系統反應不及時，電漿會在毫秒內撞向上方或下方的壁面，造成垂直位移事件。
knowledge.textEn: Elongating the cross-section improves performance but makes vertical position unstable; if the control system is too slow the plasma hits the upper or lower wall within milliseconds in a vertical displacement event.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢查確認；只更換設備、重設警報或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; swapping equipment, resetting alarms or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 關於「一億度的意義」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "What a hundred million degrees means" is correct?
options: 一億度的電漿會把任何容器都燒穿。
只要磁場夠強，電漿壓力可以無限提高。
氘與氚的原子核都帶正電，互相排斥；要讓它們靠得夠近而融合，粒子必須有極高的動能，也就是極高的溫度。
optionsEn: Plasma at a hundred million degrees would burn through any container.
With a strong enough field, plasma pressure can be raised without limit.
Deuterium and tritium nuclei are both positive and repel; to come close enough to fuse, particles need very high kinetic energy, that is very high temperature.
quiz.explanation: 氘與氚的原子核都帶正電，互相排斥；要讓它們靠得夠近而融合，粒子必須有極高的動能，也就是極高的溫度。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Deuterium and tritium nuclei are both positive and repel; to come close enough to fuse, particles need very high kinetic energy, that is very high temperature. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 一億度的意義：機制與能量路徑
steps.titleEn: What a hundred million degrees means: mechanism and energy path
steps.objective: 說明「一億度的意義」如何決定「KSTAR 韓國超導托卡馬克」的能量轉換、輸送、儲存或安全功能，並畫出輸入、轉換、損失與系統邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “What a hundred million degrees means” governs energy conversion, transfer, storage or safety functions in “KSTAR Korea Superconducting Tokamak”, and map inputs, conversions, losses and the system boundary.
steps.instruction: 氘與氚的原子核都帶正電，互相排斥；要讓它們靠得夠近而融合，粒子必須有極高的動能，也就是極高的溫度。融合研究習慣用能量單位「千電子伏特」來表示溫度：一千電子伏特相當於約一千一百六十萬度。氘氚反應在一萬到兩萬電子伏特之間最容易發生，所以一億度大約是最低門檻。太陽核心只有一千五百萬度，它靠的是巨大的重力與極長的時間；地球上的裝置密度低得多，必須用更高的溫度來補償。 師傅任務：畫出這個單元的能量與物質流圖（輸入、轉換、損失、輸出、邊界），標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由資源、環境或運轉決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Deuterium and tritium nuclei are both positive and repel; to come close enough to fuse, particles need very high kinetic energy, that is very high temperature. Fusion research expresses temperature in an energy unit, the kilo-electron-volt, one of which corresponds to about 11.6 million degrees. The deuterium-tritium reaction goes most readily between ten and twenty kilo-electron-volts, so a hundred million degrees is roughly the minimum. The Sun's core is only fifteen million degrees and relies on immense gravity and very long times; devices on Earth are far less dense and must compensate with higher temperature. Mentor task: draw the energy and material flow of this unit (inputs, conversions, losses, outputs, boundary), mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by resource, environment or operation, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 工程檔案：2008 年產生第一個電漿
steps.observationEn: Project file: First plasma was in 2008
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「一億度的電漿會把任何容器都燒穿。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在流程圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Plasma at a hundred million degrees would burn through any container." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your flow diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 流程圖標明「一億度的意義」的輸入、轉換、損失與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The flow diagram shows inputs, conversions, losses and boundary for “What a hundred million degrees means”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

quiz.question: 依「一億度的意義」的模型 T[keV] = T[K]·k / e，一億度（10⁸ K）換算成千電子伏特最接近下列何者？
quiz.questionEn: Using the model T[keV] = T[K]·k / e for "What a hundred million degrees means", which value is closest to the a hundred million kelvin converted to kilo-electron-volts?
options: 8.6 keV
86.2 keV
4.31 keV
optionsEn: 8.6 keV
86.2 keV
4.31 keV
quiz.explanation: T[keV] = T[K]·k / e；代入 T = 1e8 K，得 8.6 keV（一億度（10⁸ K）換算成千電子伏特）。 其餘選項是倍數或數量級錯誤。
quiz.explanationEn: T[keV] = T[K]·k / e; with T = 1e8 K the result is 8.6 keV (a hundred million kelvin converted to kilo-electron-volts). The other options are factor or order-of-magnitude errors.

steps.title: 一億度的意義：定量估算
steps.titleEn: What a hundred million degrees means: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「一億度的意義」的關鍵量，並判斷輸入改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantity of “What a hundred million degrees means” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when an input moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：T[keV] = T[K]·k / e；代入 T = 1e8 K，得 8.6 keV（一億度（10⁸ K）換算成千電子伏特）。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次；再把 T 增加 10%，先預測再計算輸出，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出設計或規範通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: T[keV] = T[K]·k / e; with T = 1e8 K the result is 8.6 keV (a hundred million kelvin converted to kilo-electron-volts). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units; then raise T by 10%, predict before computing the output, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how designers or codes usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 敏感度核對：T 增加 10% 時，結果變為 9.5 keV（+10.0%）。
steps.observationEn: Sensitivity check: Raising T by 10% changes the result to 9.5 keV (+10.0%).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成實機設計值、混淆額定值與實際運轉值，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as plant design values, mixing rated and actual operating values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later decisions.
steps.check: 重現 8.6 keV（取整誤差 ±2% 內），並提交 T 改變 10% 的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce 8.6 keV (within ±2% rounding) and submit the sensitivity calculation for a 10% change in T with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: T[keV] = T[K]·k / e；代入 T = 1e8 K，得 8.6 keV（一億度（10⁸ K）換算成千電子伏特）。
knowledge.textEn: T[keV] = T[K]·k / e; with T = 1e8 K the result is 8.6 keV (a hundred million kelvin converted to kilo-electron-volts).

knowledge.title: 敏感度
knowledge.text: T 增加 10% 時，結果變為 9.5 keV（+10.0%）。 先預測方向與次方，再用計算確認。
knowledge.textEn: Raising T by 10% changes the result to 9.5 keV (+10.0%). Predict direction and exponent first, then confirm by calculation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為公開標稱值或教學假設的簡化；套用到實際設備前，必須依規範、製造商資料與現場量測重新計算。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are public nominal values or simplified teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, recalculate with codes, manufacturer data and site measurements.

quiz.question: 要驗證「一億度的意義」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "What a hundred million degrees means"?
options: 沿用另一座電廠或另一台機組的試驗結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
離子溫度以電荷交換複合光譜量測：中性束與雜質離子交換電荷後發出的譜線，其都卜勒展寬反映離子的熱運動。
電漿電流越大越好，沒有上限。
optionsEn: Reusing test results from another plant or unit counts as verifying this project.
Ion temperature is measured by charge-exchange recombination spectroscopy: lines emitted after impurity ions exchange charge with a neutral beam are Doppler-broadened by ion thermal motion.
The larger the plasma current the better, with no upper limit.
quiz.explanation: 離子溫度以電荷交換複合光譜量測：中性束與雜質離子交換電荷後發出的譜線，其都卜勒展寬反映離子的熱運動。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Ion temperature is measured by charge-exchange recombination spectroscopy: lines emitted after impurity ions exchange charge with a neutral beam are Doppler-broadened by ion thermal motion. Verification needs a baseline, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 一億度的意義：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: What a hundred million degrees means: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「一億度的意義」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停留點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “What a hundred million degrees means” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 離子溫度以電荷交換複合光譜量測：中性束與雜質離子交換電荷後發出的譜線，其都卜勒展寬反映離子的熱運動。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器、基準或校正、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停留點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Ion temperature is measured by charge-exchange recombination spectroscopy: lines emitted after impurity ions exchange charge with a neutral beam are Doppler-broadened by ion thermal motion. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments, baseline or calibration, procedure, comparison, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：溫度紀錄要同時說明密度、高溫區的範圍與維持時間，才能換算成有意義的融合性能。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: A temperature record should state density, extent of the hot region and duration as well, so it can be turned into meaningful fusion performance.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：高離子溫度若只出現在很小的核心區域或靠非熱平衡的快離子維持，整體的融合性能並不如數字所暗示的那麼高。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境與運轉條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A high ion temperature confined to a tiny core region, or kept up by non-thermal fast ions, means overall fusion performance is less than the number suggests. A single reading, no traceable baseline, or unrecorded ambient and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停留點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, baseline, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 離子溫度以電荷交換複合光譜量測：中性束與雜質離子交換電荷後發出的譜線，其都卜勒展寬反映離子的熱運動。
knowledge.textEn: Ion temperature is measured by charge-exchange recombination spectroscopy: lines emitted after impurity ions exchange charge with a neutral beam are Doppler-broadened by ion thermal motion.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 溫度紀錄要同時說明密度、高溫區的範圍與維持時間，才能換算成有意義的融合性能。
knowledge.textEn: A temperature record should state density, extent of the hot region and duration as well, so it can be turned into meaningful fusion performance.

knowledge.title: 規範與標準
knowledge.text: 可對照的公開規範或指引：IAEA 融合設施安全相關技術文件。引用時須確認版次與適用範圍。
knowledge.textEn: A public code or guide to compare against: IAEA technical documents on safety of fusion facilities. Confirm edition and applicability before citing it.

quiz.question: 在「一億度的意義」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "What a hundred million degrees means" shows an anomaly, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 把警報門檻調寬，就能解決大多數異常。
只要磁場夠強，電漿壓力可以無限提高。
高離子溫度若只出現在很小的核心區域或靠非熱平衡的快離子維持，整體的融合性能並不如數字所暗示的那麼高。
optionsEn: Widening the alarm thresholds resolves most anomalies.
With a strong enough field, plasma pressure can be raised without limit.
A high ion temperature confined to a tiny core region, or kept up by non-thermal fast ions, means overall fusion performance is less than the number suggests.
quiz.explanation: 高離子溫度若只出現在很小的核心區域或靠非熱平衡的快離子維持，整體的融合性能並不如數字所暗示的那麼高。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A high ion temperature confined to a tiny core region, or kept up by non-thermal fast ions, means overall fusion performance is less than the number suggests. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 一億度的意義：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: What a hundred million degrees means: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「一億度的意義」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or degradation causes of “What a hundred million degrees means” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 高離子溫度若只出現在很小的核心區域或靠非熱平衡的快離子維持，整體的融合性能並不如數字所暗示的那麼高。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢查，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響「KSTAR 韓國超導托卡馬克」的安全、出力、壽命或併網。
steps.instructionEn: A high ion temperature confined to a tiny core region, or kept up by non-thermal fast ions, means overall fusion performance is less than the number suggests. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects safety, output, life or grid connection of “KSTAR Korea Superconducting Tokamak”.
steps.observation: 連結機制：太陽核心只有一千五百萬度，它靠的是巨大的重力與極長的時間；地球上的裝置密度低得多，必須用更高的溫度來補償。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The Sun's core is only fifteen million degrees and relies on immense gravity and very long times; devices on Earth are far less dense and must compensate with higher temperature.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「一億度的電漿會把任何容器都燒穿。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Plasma at a hundred million degrees would burn through any container." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢查能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 高離子溫度若只出現在很小的核心區域或靠非熱平衡的快離子維持，整體的融合性能並不如數字所暗示的那麼高。
knowledge.textEn: A high ion temperature confined to a tiny core region, or kept up by non-thermal fast ions, means overall fusion performance is less than the number suggests.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢查確認；只更換設備、重設警報或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; swapping equipment, resetting alarms or relaxing limits can mask the problem.
